body:
Continuation of incomplete draft PR #1165, roadmap Task 7. Depends on #1168 and #1169.

## Scope
- Proxy global/session SSE with heartbeat, reconnect, dedupe, abort cleanup, and bounded buffers
- Proxy PTY WebSocket authentication/upgrade plus binary/text frames and close propagation
- Reuse existing OpenCode connect-ticket semantics

## Acceptance
- Authentication occurs before stream/upgrade
- Revoked tokens cannot connect
- Disconnects release all listeners, sockets, and buffers
- Sandboxed live test observes a real SSE event and PTY input/output round trip
- Tests use only `tools/dev/sandbox.sh` on 4098/4097; never direct server startup
- GitNexus impact/detect-changes and independent review pass
title: iOS: add authenticated SSE and PTY gateway proxies
